big: Nifty Chemicals is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

lines: What does the Nifty Chemicals track?
Nifty Chemicals Index aims to track the performance of stocks from the Nifty 500 Index which form a part of the Chemicals sector. It holds 20 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.
